reels.caption:
AD Unique spaceship Airbnb in the UK 🌳 One of the cosiest Airbnbs I stayed in! #airbnbpartner This unique UK stay is around 1.5 hours from London by public transport, and truly one of the most unique Airbnbs in the UK countryside. Here is everything you need to know before you stay here with @airbnb

🚝 To get here from London, take a train to Billingshurst or Horsham and a prebooked taxi from there
🪵 It's located in the middle of the forest, so if you're not driving, be prepared for a 15-20 minute walk to the property as not all taxi companies will drop you at the property
🎒 Bring food, cooking essentials like salt, pepper, oil and butter are provided
🛌 I'd recommend a 2 nights stay which is enough to disconnect and explore the walking routes nearby (yes, there is no internet and no signal)
🦌 Of course it is not guarded that you will see deer, but we saw them both mornings, so chance are high!

For more cosy UK staycation inspo check out my Airbnb storefront collection - link in bio ✅ If you're looking for the best UK countryside retreats and unique UK Airbnbs - I've got you 💖

#ukstaycation #uniqueairbnb #uniquestays #countrysideretreat
